misconceptionText: The student interprets the value of a digit as its face value rather than its positional value, reporting the name of the digit itself regardless of where it appears in the number.
teachingImplication: Contrast face value with place value using physical or visual base-ten blocks to highlight how position scales a digit's worth.
checkNext: Ask the student for the value of a non-zero digit in the thousands place of a four-digit number.
